capabilities.description: Read the rail-light state reported by the robot.
capabilities.completion_criteria: The robot server returns a boolean light state.
limitations: Readback is the robot controller’s report. Optical output requires external observation.

capabilities.description: Switch the rail lights on or off and read back their state.
capabilities.completion_criteria: After the write, a separate read reports the requested state.
limitations: Readback is the robot controller’s report. Optical output requires external observation.
